### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

```release-note
The TiDB server now supports the `--initialize-secure` and `--initialize-insecure` (default) options on first bootstrap. The secure bootstrap option generates a root user with the `auth_socket` plugin. This provides increased security over the default behavior.
```
